name: Table
description: Rows of structured data in real table markup: a toolbar with a title, sortable headers, row selection with a select-all box, expandable rows, loading and empty states, and a footer with Pagination.

livewire.name: table
capabilities: wire:model binds the selected keys (value) through $wire.entangle()

rows takes an array, a Collection or a Laravel paginator; paginated (2.x with-pagination) renders Pagination from the paginator, and per-page names the Livewire property a "Rows per page" Select binds
Clicking a sortable header sets the component's sortBy property ({ column, direction }) when sort-by is given, as 2.x did, and dispatches sort-change

Cell content through @scope('cell_<key>', $row), header content through @scope('header_<key>', $header), row actions through @scope('actions', $row) and expanded content through @scope('expansion', $row); a dotted key such as user.name becomes cell_user___name

2.x attributes keep working: compact (density), no-headers (hideHeaders), selectable-key, expandable-key, expandable-condition, link (row links with {key} tokens), row-decoration and cell-decoration (classes from closures), the drag-and-drop sortable, sort-group and sort-handle, and infinite-scroll with has-more-pages (Livewire 4)
differences: Expansion rows render for every expandable row and toggle with Alpine; React and Vue render only the expanded ones.
Without selectable, wire:model on an expandable table binds the expanded keys, as 2.x did.

react.name: Table
capabilities: Cell content through renderCell(row, column, index), or a column's render(value, row, index); header content through renderHeader(column); row actions through renderActions(row, index); expanded content through renderExpansion(row, index)

vue.name: Table
capabilities: v-model binds the selected keys, v-model:expanded the expanded keys and v-model:sort-by the sort

Cell content through #cell-<key>="{ row, value, column, index }" or #cell for every column; header content through #header-<key>="{ column }"; row actions through #actions="{ row, index }"; expanded content through #expansion="{ row, index }"

props.name: headers
props.description: The columns, in order: { key, label, sortable, numeric, hidden, secondary, class }. key is a dot path into each row. sortable makes the header a sort button (Livewire 2.x: every header sorts once sortBy is set, unless sortable is false). numeric end-aligns the column with tabular figures. secondary is a second dot path, shown muted under the value. Livewire also takes format (a closure or ['currency', '2.,', '$'] / ['date', 'M j, Y']), sortBy (the column to sort by) and disableLink.

props.name: rows
props.description: The rows: arrays or objects. Livewire also takes a Collection or a paginator.

props.name: keyBy
props.description: The dot path to each row's unique key, used for selection, expansion and list keys.

props.name: title
props.description: The title at the start of the toolbar. It names the table unless label is set.
props.a11y: The table's accessible name comes from title (aria-labelledby) or label (aria-label); give every table one.

props.name: label
props.description: The table's accessible name when it has no visible title, or a different one. Translate it.

props.name: density
props.description: Row height, cell padding and type size, as data-density on the root. Unset, the table follows the page's density. Use compact for operational screens and comfortable for browsing.

props.name: surface
props.description: glass puts the table on a translucent surface; the header row turns transparent.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Keeps the header row in view while the rows scroll. The scroll part needs a height for it to matter: set --apui-table-max-block-size on the root.

props.name: hideHeaders
props.description: Hides the header row visually. Screen readers still announce the column names. Livewire 2.x's no-headers still works.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Adds a checkbox to every row and a select-all box to the header. The select-all box is mixed while some rows of the page are selected.
props.a11y: Row boxes are named by selectRowLabel and selected rows carry aria-selected="true".

props.name: value
props.description: The selected rows' keys. Select all adds or removes the keys of the rows on screen, keeping any others.

props.name: expandable
props.description: Adds a button to each row that shows the expansion content in a full-width row under it.

props.name: expanded
props.description: The expanded rows' keys.

props.name: sortBy
props.description: The current sort: { column, direction }, direction "asc" or "desc". The sorted header carries aria-sort; the table never sorts rows itself, so sort them where they come from on sort-change.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows skeleton rows in place of the rows and sets aria-busy on the root.
props.a11y: The root carries aria-busy="true"; the skeleton rows are aria-hidden.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: The EmptyState title shown in a full-width row when there are no rows. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'No records found.' ). The empty slot replaces the whole state.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Content after the title in the toolbar, such as a search Input and Buttons.

props.name: footer
props.description: Content at the start of the footer, such as "1 selected · 4 of 128". Pagination sits at its end.

props.name: pagination
props.description: Pagination's props ({ page, total, perPage, pageCount, siblings, summary, labels }), rendered at the end of the footer. React and Vue take its page-change handler there too (onPageChange).

props.name: paginated
props.description: Renders Pagination from the paginator in rows (2.x: with-pagination). Inside a component using WithPagination, the pages call gotoPage() without a reload.

props.name: perPage
props.description: With paginated, the Livewire property a "Rows per page" Select in the footer binds (wire:model.live).

props.name: perPageValues
props.description: The "Rows per page" options.

props.name: selectAllLabel
props.description: The select-all box's accessible name. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Select all' ).

props.name: selectRowLabel
props.description: Each row box's accessible name; {row} is the row's first column. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Select {row}' ).

props.name: sortLabel
props.description: Each sort button's accessible name; {column} is the column's label. aria-sort on the header announces the current order. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Sort by {column}' ).

props.name: expandLabel
props.description: Each expand button's accessible name; {row} is the row's first column. aria-expanded announces whether it is open. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Show details for {row}' ).

props.name: actionsLabel
props.description: The row-actions column's header, for screen readers only. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Actions' ).

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { headCell: '…', cell: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The frame: surface, border and radius around the toolbar, the grid and the footer.

parts.name: toolbar
parts.description: The row above the grid holding the title and the toolbar content. Only renders with one of them.

parts.name: title
parts.description: The table's title; it names the table.

parts.name: scroll
parts.description: Scrolls the grid sideways on narrow screens, and down past --apui-table-max-block-size.

parts.name: headCell
parts.description: A column header (scope="col"). A sortable one carries aria-sort and holds the sort button.

parts.name: sort
parts.description: The sort button inside a sortable header: the label, then an icon for the current order.

parts.name: row
parts.description: A body row. With selectable, it carries aria-selected.

parts.name: cell
parts.description: A body cell. Numeric columns carry data-numeric.

parts.name: select
parts.description: The checkbox column: the select-all box in the header, a row's box in each row. Holds a Checkbox.

parts.name: expandTrigger
parts.description: Shows or hides a row's expansion. Icon-only, named by expandLabel, with aria-expanded and aria-controls. Its chevron turns down when open and mirrors in RTL.

parts.name: expansion
parts.description: The full-width row under an expanded row, holding the expansion content.

parts.name: primary
parts.description: A cell's main value when its column has secondary.

parts.name: secondary
parts.description: The muted second line under primary.

parts.name: footer
parts.description: The row under the grid: the footer content at the start, Pagination at the end.

slots.name: toolbar
slots.description: Content after the title in the toolbar.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Content at the start of the footer. In Livewire, a footer slot that holds table rows (<tr>) still renders in a <tfoot>, as in 2.x.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Replaces the empty state, such as an EmptyState with an action.

slots.name: cell
slots.description: A column's cell content, given the row. Blade @scope('cell_<key>', $row), Vue #cell-<key>, React renderCell.

slots.name: header
slots.description: A column's header content, given the column. Blade @scope('header_<key>', $header), Vue #header-<key>, React renderHeader.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Row actions in a last, end-aligned column, given the row. Blade @scope('actions', $row), Vue #actions, React renderActions.

slots.name: expansion
slots.description: An expanded row's content, given the row. Blade @scope('expansion', $row), Vue #expansion, React renderExpansion.

events.name: value-change
events.description: The selection changed, by a row box or select all. The payload is the selected keys. Setting value doesn't fire it.

events.name: sort-change
events.description: A sortable header was chosen. The payload is the next sort: ascending first, then toggling. Livewire dispatches it as a browser event with { column, direction } in $event.detail.

events.name: expanded-change
events.description: A row was expanded or collapsed. The payload is the expanded keys.

events.name: row-click
events.description: A row was clicked outside its links, buttons and boxes. The payload is the row. In Livewire it fires only when something listens on the table (x-on:row-click, @row-click or wire:row-click).

keyboard.action: Moves through the select-all box, the sort buttons, then each row's box, expand button and the links and buttons in its cells.
On a sort button, sorts by that column (ascending, then toggling); on an expand button, shows or hides the row's expansion.
On a checkbox, selects or clears the row, or every row on screen for select all.

requirements: Real table markup: a table with thead and tbody, header cells with scope="col".
The table is named by its title (aria-labelledby) or label (aria-label).
A sortable header carries aria-sort (ascending, descending or none) and holds a button named by sortLabel; the icon is decorative.
Row boxes are named by selectRowLabel and selected rows carry aria-selected="true"; the select-all box is named by selectAllLabel and is mixed (indeterminate) while some rows are selected.
Expand buttons are named by expandLabel and carry aria-expanded and aria-controls; the chevron mirrors in RTL.
While loading, the root carries aria-busy="true" and the skeleton rows are aria-hidden.
Focus is visible on every control; a focused cell uses an inset ring so it never overlaps its neighbors.
Numbers end-align with tabular figures; status uses a Badge, never a whole-row color.
